title: The report divides a bare research twin's tokens and USD by the kb agent's verified facts, so its per-verified-fact figure measures nothing the twin did
goal: the multi report's kb-versus-bare comparison shows a research twin's own facts_matched beside the kb agent's facts_verified, and labels the twin's per-verified-fact figure not comparable (or leaves it out) instead of dividing the twin's spend by the kb agent's count

run:
import re
t = open('kb/_self/reports/benchmarks.md', encoding='utf-8').read()
s = t[t.index('### Agents at once against agents one at a time'):]
assert 'facts_matched' in s or 'facts matched' in s, 'the multi comparison never shows a twin\'s own matched facts'
assert re.search(r'not comparable', s), 'a bare twin\'s per-verified-fact figure divides by the kb agent\'s count with no label'
